# JobHunter by SuperMIA

> JobHunter (also called Job Hunter) is an AI job search and interview practice app from SuperMIA, operated by Botfinity Inc. in Grapevine, Texas. It searches LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice in one search, scores your resume for each job out of 100 with the reasoning and missing skills, drafts an application email for the role, and runs live voice mock interviews with a 0-10 readiness score. It never applies to jobs or sends anything without the user.

## Product

- [JobHunter home](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/): AI job search across LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice, resume match score, application email and live interview practice.
- [Start or sign in](https://app.jobhunter.supermia.ai): the JobHunter web app.
- [Brochure (PDF, 8 pages)](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/brochure/job-hunter-brochure.pdf): the product story, no sign-up needed.
- [Demo video (47 seconds)](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/video/jobhunter-ai-demo.mp4)
- [FAQ](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/faq): how JobHunter works, what it never does and what happens to your data.
- [Pricing](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/pricing): Free plan, Starter at $15 a month and Pro at $30 a month; plans differ in monthly limits.

## Features

- [AI Mock Interview](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/ai-mock-interview): four rounds out loud with follow-up questions and a scorecard.
- [Resume Job Match](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/resume-job-match): a match score out of 100 for one job, the missing skills and what to fix first.
- [Application Email Writer](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/job-application-email): a short email for each role, drafted from your resume, that you edit and send.
- [AI Job Match](https://jobhunter.supermia.ai/ai-job-match): LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice in one search, ranked by fit with your resume.

## Key facts

- Job boards searched: LinkedIn, Indeed, Dice (third-party services; their own terms and privacy policies apply when you use them).
- Mock interview rounds: HR & Introduction; Role & Knowledge; Practical & Behavioral; Managerial & Final.
- Practice modes: guided practice (with hints) and real simulation (strict).
- Scorecard: readiness score 0-10, clarity, confidence, technical depth, strengths, gaps, topics to practice.
- Users can keep several resume versions.
- Minimum age: 16. Contact: hello@supermia.ai
